title: What Ultrasound Technologists Do
description: Sonographers use high-frequency sound waves to image the body's insides — abdomen, pelvis, heart, vessels, pregnancies — without radiation. They operate the transducer, optimize images in real time, take precise measurements, and write technical impressions for physicians. They are the hands and eyes of ultrasound diagnosis.
